subject: Mustang Health go-live readiness — sales->CS handoff & open risk register
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire@mustanghealth.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@mustanghealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mustang Health go-live readiness — sales->CS handoff & open risk register

Claire — thanks again for the productive demo last week. We're aligned on the planned go-live window the week of Aug 16 and the high-level scope (chat + contextual retrieval for patient support). This thread transitions the conversation into an operational handoff so CS/Implementation can pick up the work.

Quick summary for context:
- Deal value: $345k ARR (first-year committed Dedicated tier)
- License term: 12 months + option for dedicated capacity increase after Q1 usage review
- Payment: PO expected by 7/30; procurement@mustanghealth.com is looped
- Technical contacts: Raj Patel (customer infra lead), Claire Reynolds (product owner)

Known risks / open items (need CS confirmation):
1) Network egress and firewall rules — customer requests specific IP ranges for dedicated pool; they will confirm by 7/23.
2) PII ingestion form — they have sample dataset classification outstanding (Raj to provide)
3) Timeline compression — requested a 2-week pilot window before full go-live; we suggested Aug 2–Aug 16 pilot then scale.

Attachments: SOW v1, preflight guide, network checklist.

Owners: I'll propose primary CS lead below, but please confirm.

Next steps I need from CS: assign primary implementation owner, confirm preflight dependencies, confirm the pilot dates (if accepted).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Reynolds <claire@mustanghealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@mustanghealth.com>, procurement@mustanghealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mustang Health go-live readiness — sales->CS handoff & open risk register

Ben — appreciate the concise summary. Confirming:
- We can target the pilot Aug 2–Aug 16 (internal approval pending, hoping to confirm by 7/22).
- Raj will send the sample dataset and a list of the categories that might be PII by 7/21.
- Procurement is reviewing the SOW; PO ETA 7/30.

Can you confirm whether dedicated pool IP ranges can be reduced to a /28 for our network security team? If not, we will need a short exception process.

Best,
Claire
Product Lead, Mustang Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Reynolds <claire@mustanghealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@mustanghealth.com>, procurement@mustanghealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Mustang Health — sales handoff and suggested owners (please ack)

Team — moving this into CS. Suggested owners below based on availability and past experience with healthcare customers: 
- Primary CS/Implementation Lead: Marissa Cole (post-sale kickoffs + data ingestion)
- Technical Implementation (network/security): Karthik Iyer (networks & private deployments)
- Executive Sponsor / Escalation contact: Tessa Morgan (manager for the CS squad)

Key asks for the first 7 days after assignment:
- Confirm pilot dates and articulate success criteria for the pilot (what does 'success' look like?)
- Validate the network checklist items with the Mustang infra team; map any items needing exceptions
- Triage PII/data classification with Raj — we should produce a short ingestion plan and redaction recommendations before pilot start

Attachments included: Mustang_SOW_v1.pdf (redlines from legal), redwood_preflight_guide.pdf, network_requirements_checklist.xlsx

Ben
On attachments: SOW is draft; legal redlines highlighted. DocuSign link will be sent after PO is in.
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Mustang Health — sales handoff and suggested owners (please ack)

Thanks Ben — I accept exec escalation. Marissa / Karthik, can you both confirm by EOD tomorrow that you can lead the items below? Also please do a quick read of the SOW and flag anything blocking for legal/procurement.

Marissa: please draft a 30/60/90 playbook for Mustang (high level bullets OK) that we can share with the customer during the kickoff meeting. Priorities: pilot acceptance criteria, data ingestion steps, and rollback plan.

Karthik: please validate the network checklist against our Dedicated IP options and call out whether /28 is feasible or we'll need /24. If /28 is feasible, include any additional firewall or NAT requirements.

I'll schedule a 30-min internal sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT to align owners. Ben — please include Raj's dataset when it's available.

-Tessa
Customer Success Manager (Team Lead), Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Reynolds <claire@mustanghealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Mustang Health — sales handoff and suggested owners (please ack)

Tessa — confirming I can own the implementation lead role. Initial questions after scanning the SOW and preflight: 
1) Do we have any explicit SLAs in the SOW for response times during the pilot? I didn't see the standard pilot SLA called out. If procurement expects a pilot SLA, we should add the language.
2) For data ingestion: Raj, can you confirm whether the sample dataset includes PHI (I imagine yes). If it is PHI, we'll need to run through our allowed-data intake checklist and recommend a minimal anonymization step before initial indexing.
3) Pilot scope — is the pilot limited to 3 endpoints, or should we include the 10 internal agents the product team demoed? Claire — please advise.

I'll draft the 30/60/90 bullets today and share in the internal drive (link to follow).

-Marissa
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Reynolds <claire@mustanghealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@mustanghealth.com>, procurement@mustanghealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Mustang Health — sales handoff and suggested owners (please ack)

Thanks all — confirmation and next steps: 
- Marissa: primary implementation lead confirmed. Share the 30/60/90 draft when ready and we will include in kickoff invite.
- Karthik: if you can validate the IP sizing today, I'll let Claire know whether the /28 exception route is needed.
- Tessa: please own the kickoff scheduling (I'll provide calendar availability)

Claire/Raj — we will aim to have the preflight checklist validated by 7/23 so customer network and legal have time to review before the pilot. If procurement pushes PO later than 7/30, we'll note the risk to the Aug 2 pilot start and propose the alternative pilot start of Aug 16.

Attaching the SOW/redlines and the preflight checklist in this thread again for easy access.

Ben
(Attachments referenced above are included in thread: Mustang_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood_preflight_guide.pdf, network_requirements_checklist.xlsx)
